about: ENGINE e94 (NUMBER PENDING, fix/pine-e94-deterministic-budgets): no answer depends on how fast the machine is. The translator's window trips the WHOLE call by name (a latch every clock limb sets, so a swallowed throw cannot leave a partial translation), a deterministic per-call step budget bounds the call, and the member door's own runs read a clock that never moves. Every rule, broken once, must turn its rail red.
